verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a consumer and workforce mobile authenticator app for MFA codes, push approvals, passkeys and Verified IDs. It is not a developer-facing service or API with production data that a user would test against, so a sandbox environment is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any test or sandbox mode, and probes found no public API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
